data.title: Iranian Military Says It Has Shown a New Model of Resistance, Will Not Surrender to the U.S.
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Armed Forces Chief of Staff Abdolrahim said Iran will not surrender to the United States and that U.S. pressure through soft power warfare, cognitive warfare, and economic warfare cannot force Iran to change its stance. He said the United States had wrongly assumed Iran would choose to surrender before taking military action against Iran, but that this assumption will not materialize. Abdolrahim also said the United States is now trying to make up for its strategic failure in the military field through soft power warfare, cognitive warfare, and economic pressure, but that these measures will also fail to achieve their goal. He added that Iran has shown the world a new model of resistance.

data.title: Eight Chinese Financial Institutions Receive RMB 360 Billion Capital Injection
data.description: Eight financial institutions, including Agricultural Bank of China (1288), Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (1398), China Life Group, PICC (1339), China Taiping Insurance, China Exim Bank, China Export & Credit Insurance, and China Reinsurance, have each received capital injections from the Ministry of Finance and other parties, with the total amount currently standing at RMB 360 billion, according to Ming Pao.

data.title: STOCKS | U.S. and Canadian Markets to Close on September 7 as CME and ICE Set Early Trading Ends
data.description: According to Jin10, U.S. and Canadian stock markets will be closed for one day on September 7, Monday, due to the U.S. Labor Day holiday. CME precious metals and U.S. crude oil futures trading will end early at 02:30 (UTC+8) on September 8, index futures trading will end early at 01:00 (UTC+8) on September 8, and ICE Brent crude futures trading will end early at 01:30 (UTC+8) on September 8.

data.title: Offchain Labs Co-Founder Says ARB Unlocks Near Completion, DAO Holds 2.84 Billion Tokens
data.description:
Offchain Labs co-founder Steven Goldfeder said market data has overstated ARB’s locked supply by counting tokens held by the DAO as locked. According to Odaily, he said investor and team unlock schedules are nearly complete and are expected to finish by next March, leaving locked tokens at about 7.7% of ARB’s total supply.

Goldfeder added that Arbitrum DAO currently holds about 2.84 billion ARB. He said these tokens are not locked in the traditional sense, but their use is controlled by governance votes from ARB holders.

data.title: NIP Favored Over LGD in LPL Playoff Match on predict.fun
data.description:
The predict.fun market for the LPL playoff match between NIP and LGD shows NIP with a 65% chance of winning. According to Odaily, the loser of the best-of-five match at 5 p.m. today will be eliminated from the playoffs, while the winner will face IG in the next round for a spot in the bubble stage.

NIP advanced after a 3-0 sweep of JDG in the first round of the lower bracket yesterday and previously eliminated EDG by the same score in the Knights Road stage. LGD reached the lower bracket after a 3-2 comeback over TES in the first playoff round, then fell 1-3 to AL.

data.title: PAIR Reports Nearly $100 Million in Trading Volume and Teases Major Update
data.description: PAIR, a multi-pool RWA token issuance platform on Robinhood Chain, said its cumulative trading volume has approached $100 million, creator rewards have exceeded $600,000, and more than 2,000 projects have launched on the protocol. According to ChainCatcher, the platform also said it has burned more than $3 million worth of PAIR tokens, representing over 10% of the total supply. PAIR added that it will announce what it described as its largest update to date within the next 24 hours.

data.title: DeFi Researcher Ignas Says AI Is Changing Liquidity Provision Strategies, Not Meme Coin Trading
data.description:
DeFi researcher Ignas said on X that finding Meme coins in the AI era has not fundamentally changed the way they are traded. According to Odaily, he said Grok typically recommends Meme coins based on historical data such as views, trading volume, and post counts on X.

Ignas said real Meme coin trading still requires human judgment on whether a project has breakout potential, including market sentiment, community atmosphere, narrative appeal, and whether key opinion leaders suddenly begin promoting it. He added that staying online 24/7 to track shifts in market sentiment remains more effective than asking AI once a day what to buy.

Ignas said AI is changing liquidity provision strategies. He said his AI agent can automatically screen liquidity pools and analyze trading volume, fees, fee trends, liquidity depth, and suitable price ranges. He said the strategy is still being refined, but it has already formed a methodology that can be continuously improved and compounded.

Ignas said that if Meme coin trading and being online around the clock are not suitable, using AI to learn and execute liquidity provision strategies may be an easier skill to master.

data.title: Binance Wallet Expands LP Zap, Markets Page, and Web3 API Features
data.description:
Binance Wallet announced on X that it has updated several product features across its wallet, web, and API tools. LP Zap now supports more EVM chains, while the LP pop-up has been upgraded to include range view and liquidity removal functions. The Markets page has also been refreshed with Overview, Meme, and Stocks sections. In addition, the Tokenized Securities detail page now supports perpetuals trading and Square, and the Extension now supports Dust Conversion.

Feature Updates

The announcement also said the Web3 API has been updated with BSC DeFi, B402 payments, and permissions. On the web version, token notification pop-ups now display market cap information, and search now supports one-click purchases through Flash Buy. Token detail pages also now support customizable metrics. Binance Wallet did not provide additional details beyond the list of feature changes in the update.

data.title: Bitcoin and Gold 90-Day Correlation Rises to 0.50, Nearing 2020 High
data.description:
The Kobeissi Letter said Bitcoin and gold are moving more closely in tandem, with their 90-day correlation rising to +0.50, nearly matching the record high set during the 2020 pandemic period. According to ChainCatcher, the figure has more than doubled since the start of the year.

The account said the correlation had previously climbed to +0.30 after the 2022 bear market recovery. It added that the recent acceleration came after the U.S. Treasury announced on August 19 that it would at least double the size of its long-term bond buybacks, raising each operation from $2 billion to $4 billion.

At the same time, Bitcoin's 90-day correlation with the Nasdaq 100 has fallen to about 0.30, a one-year low. The account said investors are increasingly using both gold and Bitcoin as hedges against currency debasement.

data.title: Lotus Launches Three Top-Tier Performance Models on the Same Day
data.description:
On August 31, Lotus officially launched the Emira 420 Sport, Emeya 900 GOLD and Eletre 900 GOLD, according to Jiemian News. The three models cover a gasoline sports car, a pure electric sedan and a pure electric SUV, alongside the plug-in hybrid SUV For Me in Lotus' current multi-powertrain lineup. The update focuses on weight reduction, aerodynamics, chassis tuning and sustained high-load performance.

The Emira 420 Sport keeps its mid-engine rear-wheel-drive layout and uses AMG's M139 2.0T engine with an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission. It accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 3.9 seconds and has a top speed above 300 km/h. Lotus also lowered the body by 5 mm, retuned the suspension geometry and offers Multimatic two-way 11-stage adjustable dampers. With optional packages, the car's weight is reduced by about 25 kg, while aerodynamic changes add about 25 kg of downforce.

The Emeya 900 GOLD and Eletre 900 GOLD continue Lotus' dual-motor electric performance strategy. Both deliver 905 horsepower and 985 Nm of peak torque. The Emeya does 0-100 km/h in 2.78 seconds with a top speed of 256 km/h, while the Eletre does it in 2.95 seconds and reaches 265 km/h. Both models now include 10-piston carbon-ceramic brakes, carbon-fiber components and lightweight wheels as standard, with the Emeya getting 22-inch carbon-fiber wheels and a carbon-fiber roof, and the Eletre using 23-inch forged wheels with carbon-fiber inserts.

Lotus priced the three models in the 900,000 yuan to 1.2 million yuan range. Jiemian News noted that the models face established performance cars such as the Porsche 718, AMG GT, Taycan and the all-electric Cayenne, while lower-priced high-performance EVs in China are squeezing room for premium pricing based mainly on horsepower and acceleration.

data.title: Turkey's Finance Minister Says Inflation Has Not Reached Desired Level
